title: Malaria Treatment Protocol Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use first-line ACT therapy for uncomplicated malaria when local policy and species pattern support it.
Escalate immediately to parenteral artesunate and inpatient management when severe malaria features are present.
Review pregnancy status, age, oral tolerance, and species pattern before finalizing therapy.

title: Tuberculosis Programmatic Care Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Select TB regimen against drug-susceptibility pattern and confirm whether rifampicin resistance is present before standardizing therapy.
Coordinate HIV co-management, adherence support, and toxicity monitoring early when co-infection exists.
Escalate specialist review when MDR/RR-TB, severe toxicity, treatment failure, or complicated extrapulmonary disease is suspected.

title: Immunization Catch-up Schedule Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use age and documented prior doses to rebuild the schedule rather than restarting a vaccine series unnecessarily.
Prioritize overdue primary-series and outbreak-relevant vaccines when multiple doses are missing.
Document minimum interval constraints clearly before giving accelerated catch-up doses.

title: PMTCT MER Indicator Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Track PMTCT indicators against documented HIV status, ART status, and maternal-infant follow-up milestones.
Escalate review when maternal viral suppression, ART continuity, or infant prophylaxis milestones are missing.
Preserve cohort definitions and reporting period logic consistently when computing MER outputs.
